list_definitions.list_1_approved_only_when_bearing_requir: Approved ONLY when bearing the required kosher symbol. This is the agency's CONDITION OF APPROVAL. It is NOT a claim that any bottle was physically observed carrying the mark.
list_definitions.list_2_approved_without_symbol: The agency permits the product without looking for a symbol.
list_definitions.list_3_approved_only_with_symbol: Approved ONLY IF the bottle bears the named symbol (same source fact as List 1).

separate_facts.symbol_required_for_approval: The agency requires the symbol for the product to be approved.
separate_facts.certification_recorded: A certifier is named. Not a claim about the label.
separate_facts.physical_symbol_independently_observed: ALWAYS "no_evidence" in this dataset. No bottle was inspected. NO EVIDENCE. No bottle was physically inspected, and neither agency listing reports physical observation of a label. The agency condition establishes what is REQUIRED for approval, not what has been OBSERVED on any particular bottle.

agency_comparisons.rule: Silence (null) is never reported as "no symbol required".

change_policy: This dataset is FROZEN. Classifications are final and must not be changed.
The ONLY permitted trigger for a change is NEW OFFICIAL EVIDENCE from STAR-K or cRc - a change on their published listing, or official agency wording that corrects a category assignment.
Convenience, inference, a producer website, a retailer, a search result or an AI summary are NOT sufficient grounds to alter a kosher status or a list membership.
Any permitted change must: cite the official source and date, update record_fingerprint_sha256_16, append to change_log, and regenerate every derived file.
The record fingerprint below is the frozen baseline. If it no longer matches, the records were altered.

change_log.detail: Dataset accepted as final verified. No classification may change without new official evidence.
